races.paceDynamic: Allroadsleadtorome emerges as the sole confirmed front-runner in this maiden field, likely to dictate terms with minimal early pressure. The prominent runners L'As de Watt, Mento and Facile Ocean may track him but lack proven pace-forcing tendencies, creating a moderate gallop. A large cohort of hold-up horses including Gunnery Sergeant, Captain Hanley, Imarajan and Mighty Berkshire will look to close late. This sustainable pace followed by a scramble from the back strongly favours hold-up performers who can time their challenges effectively.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Allroadsleadtorome unchallenged early
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets perfect conditions to close strongly, with the experienced campaigners having crucial advantages over the debutants. Gunnery Sergeant and Captain Hanley emerge from the pack with superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the experienced prominent runners can secure ideal position behind the leader
scenarios.body: L'As de Watt or Facile Ocean travels smoothly in behind before quickening when the hold-up horses are still gathering momentum. Their positioning advantage proves decisive in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Debut Winner
scenarios.trigger: If the large number of newcomers includes a well-schooled improver catching the market
scenarios.body: A debutant shows superior natural ability and race-reading to overcome inexperience in a slowly-run affair. The lack of strong form in the field opens the door for fresh talent.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wire-To-Wire Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Allroadsleadtorome faces no serious challenge and maintains his position throughout
scenarios.body: The confirmed leader dictates ideal fractions for his own stamina and holds on as the closers leave their runs too late. His recent running suggests he can sustain a gallop better than his odds suggest.

watchPoints.text: Gunnery Sergeant and Captain Hanley settling kindly in rear - their closing kicks could be devastating if the pace stays steady
Facile Ocean's tendency to race keenly early - if he settles better he becomes a major player from prominent position
Market movements on the Hanlon debutants The Red Lad and Sonna Lady - any strong support would indicate hidden ability
Allroadsleadtorome's ability to sustain his gallop - previous form suggests he can outstay these if not pressured early
L'As de Watt's jumping fluency - his Cork second suggests real ability if he can translate it to this longer trip

races.paceDynamic: Pets Georgina and Red Or White will dispute the early lead in this small field, with both confirmed front runners likely to set a solid gallop over the 3-mile trip. The prominent racers Local News, Master Haku and Lemmy Caution should track the leaders closely given the lack of held-up horses in the field. With no genuine hold-up performers and limited pace pressure from just two leaders, this sets up as an honest but not overly demanding gallop that should suit the prominent runners who can position handily and have the class to kick when the race develops. This pace scenario clearly favours prominent racers who can travel well and have a turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders set a reasonable pace without killing each other off early
scenarios.body: The classier prominent runners can sit in perfect tracking positions and use superior ability when the race heats up after the last. Local News and Master Haku are best positioned to exploit this scenario with their higher ratings and tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Battle Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Pets Georgina and Red Or White engage in a sustained speed duel from early in the race
scenarios.body: The pace becomes strong enough to set up the race for the best stayer among the prominent group who can pick up the pieces. Lemmy Caution's recent 3-mile win suggests he could benefit most from a truly run race over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front runners gets an uncontested lead while the other falls away or makes mistakes
scenarios.body: The free-running leader could steal a march on the field and prove hard to peg back over this stamina-sapping distance. Red Or White has shown more consistency than Pets Georgina and would be the more likely beneficiary of this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Novice Errors Decide
scenarios.trigger: If jumping mistakes or inexperience cost the market leaders at crucial stages
scenarios.body: The most reliable jumper among the remainder could capitalize on others' misfortunes in this novice event. Master Haku's Gordon Elliott schooling and recent hurdles experience could prove decisive if others falter.

watchPoints.text: Pets Georgina could cause interference again if her jumping doesn't improve from the unseating incident just 6 days ago
Red Or White needs to show more consistency than her 0-7 hurdles record suggests after repeatedly failing to convert ability into wins
Master Haku stepping up significantly in trip from his 16.5f winning distance to this 3-mile test for the first time
Lemmy Caution running back quickly after just 4 days since his poor effort at Down Royal following his Punchestown win
Local News attempting to follow up her shock 100-1 maiden win with another prominent performance against stronger opposition

races.paceDynamic: Blue Reed and Not So Serious will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid gallop in this competitive handicap. Kalsman and Brother Hollie should track the pace in prominent positions, while the majority of the field including Sheer Raz, Justicialism, Finnicky Filly and Anodandawink will settle further back. With genuine pace-setters and a competitive field, the gallop should be honest throughout the 2m3f trip. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as the early pace will set it up perfectly for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Reed and Not So Serious engage in a prolonged speed duel from flagfall
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will find out both leaders in the final half-mile, allowing the hold-up performers to pick up the pieces with strong finishing kicks. This plays directly into the hands of those settled at the rear who can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Reed gets an uncontested lead with Not So Serious settling behind
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace will allow Blue Reed to dictate terms and kick for home when it matters, while prominent trackers can also benefit from the controlled tempo. Hold-up horses may struggle to make up ground without enough pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Kalsman or Brother Hollie inject pace from the 6f pole to catch the leaders napping
scenarios.body: The sudden acceleration will stretch the field and expose those without the class or fitness to respond. This benefits horses with tactical speed who can quicken when the pace lifts rather than pure stayers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady and even from start to finish without significant changes
scenarios.body: The consistent tempo will favour horses with stamina and proven staying power over those who rely on tactical kicks. This becomes a true test of endurance where experience and fitness tell.

watchPoints.text: Blue Reed and Not So Serious could set unsustainable fractions if they engage in early speed duel
Justicialism has fading tendency late and amateur rider may not time challenge optimally
Several runners including Anodandawink and Inches Away show concerning patterns of weakening in finish
Sheer Raz benefits from tongue-tie first time and Cromwell's 18% strike rate with equipment changes
Kalsman showed benefit of comeback run last time and Down Royal form gives him solid claims here

races.paceDynamic: Premier Rogue will take the early lead with Walk Win and Laurie Blue likely to sit handy, but with only one confirmed pace-setter this sets up a moderate gallop rather than a searching test. The lack of genuine speed horses means the early pace will be comfortable, allowing the field to stay bunched longer than ideal. This moderate tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as front-runners like Premier Rogue face the risk of being swamped in the final furlong. The race shape clearly benefits hold-up performers who can stay close enough to strike in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate as expected with Premier Rogue unchallenged early
scenarios.body: The comfortable gallop allows patient riders to keep their mounts closer than usual, setting up multiple late challengers to overwhelm the leaders. Le Diablo and Diamond Secret benefit most from being able to time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If Premier Rogue and Walk Win go faster than expected or the hold-up horses fail to close
scenarios.body: The early leaders get first run on their rivals and the closing horses leave their moves too late on ground that may be testing their stamina. Premier Rogue holds on with Walk Win running into a place.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Laurie Blue or Walk Win decide to inject pace from the third flight onwards
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and exposes the stamina limitations of several runners, but still allows the classier hold-up horses to respond. This pace change suits horses with tactical speed who can bridge the gap.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Jumping Errors
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make significant jumping mistakes or there are falls/interference
scenarios.body: Poor jumping from several runners creates opportunities for those who jump cleanly and can pick up the pieces. The race becomes more about who survives than pure ability.

Make The Plan returning after 470 days off and switching back from chasing, likely needs the run

races.paceDynamic: Jackson Lamb, Apple's Of Bresil, and Mister Frostie will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with Jackson Lamb and Apple's Of Bresil both proven front-runners over similar trips. The sustained pace over 2m4½f will test stamina reserves, particularly as both main leaders have winning form at extended distances. With three confirmed pace-setters in a 10-runner field, the tempo will be honest throughout, creating opportunities for those who can settle and finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and hold-up horses who can capitalise on the expected pace collapse in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Jackson Lamb and Apple's Of Bresil maintain a relentless gallop through the first half of the race
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo will drain the leaders, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired front-runners in the closing stages. Howdoyalikeherhome and Chichester Park can exploit their stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets first run on their rivals and maintains momentum
scenarios.body: Jackson Lamb or Apple's Of Bresil could steal a decisive advantage before the field can respond, using their tactical speed to build an unassailable lead. The winner will be the most prominent horse who avoids the scramble behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly strong early and multiple horses are in contention turning for home
scenarios.body: A horse with tactical pace who has conserved energy will emerge from the pack to strike late. Billie Frechette's dual-purpose speed gives her the acceleration to capitalize when others are struggling.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Steadies Early
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners settle into a moderate rhythm rather than going hard from the start
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and recent form matter most, negating the stamina advantages of hold-up horses. Fresh legs and tactical positioning become crucial in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Jackson Lamb and Apple's Of Bresil could set unsustainable fractions given their front-running instincts and lengthy layoffs
Howdoyalikeherhome needs to jump cleanly after being pulled up in successive starts when last seen
Billie Frechette's weight advantage and recent run could prove decisive if the pace collapses as expected
Something Noble represents the only four-year-old in the field and carries the lowest weight at 151lbs
Multiple horses returning from lengthy breaks including Jackson Lamb (219d) and Apple's Of Bresil (370d) face fitness tests

races.paceDynamic: Trasna Na Pairce will lead from the outset, with Vina Ardanza, General Clermont and Warriors Wood sitting prominently behind the pace-setter. The early gallop should be honest but not frantic over this 2m4½f trip, allowing the hold-up horses like Bridie's Beau, No Flies On Him and Andys Flame to settle towards the rear. Trasna Na Pairce's front-running style creates a searching test from three out, but the combination of his inexperience over fences (0-6 record) and the sustained nature of the test means the pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up brigade. This race shape strongly favours horses that can produce late kicks from off the pace, as the early leaders will come under pressure in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Trasna Na Pairce sets steady fractions early but comes under pressure from three out.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes searching late which exposes the front-runners' stamina limitations. Patient rides on proven stayers with tactical speed prove decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If General Clermont or Vina Ardanza can track Trasna Na Pairce without over-racing.
scenarios.body: These experienced chasers can capitalize when the leader falters, using their race position to strike first. Their superior jumping experience over the novice chase horses gives them a crucial advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Trasna Na Pairce goes too fast early or makes jumping errors.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the final bend when the pace crumbles. Horses with natural speed rather than stamina benefit from the tactical change.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Trasna Na Pairce gets an uncontested lead and jumps cleanly throughout.
scenarios.body: His superior fitness from a recent run and the Henry De Bromhead stable form combine perfectly. The field fails to mount a serious challenge against his sustained gallop.

watchPoints.text: Trasna Na Pairce's jumping accuracy early - any mistakes will compromise his front-running tactics and open up the race.
Andys Flame and No Flies On Him for market confidence given both need their first runs back from long layoffs.
The pace through the first mile - if Trasna Na Pairce goes too fast early it will set up the hold-up horses perfectly.
Bridie's Beau's headgear reaction - the new tongue tie and cheekpieces combination could spark improved jumping.
General Clermont's position turning for home - his ability to track the leader without over-racing will determine his chances.
